findings.title: POST /books crashes with AttributeError on missing required fields
findings.detail: In do_POST, validation logic calls .strip() on title, author, isbn without first checking if they are None. When a required field is missing from the JSON body, data.get('field') returns None, and None.strip() raises AttributeError, resulting in a 500 error / RemoteDisconnected instead of the required 400 response for missing/empty required fields. This breaks the core validation of required fields.

findings.title: Content-Length header not properly validated in do_POST
findings.detail: If the Content-Length header contains a non-numeric value (e.g., 'abc'), the server does not handle it gracefully, which can lead to unexpected parsing errors or connection issues. The code does not validate Content-Length before attempting to read the request body.

findings.title: PUT /books validation may have inconsistent error handling
findings.detail: While do_PUT may follow similar validation patterns, it was not verified to have the same None-handling for required fields as do_POST. If missing fields are not handled consistently, PUT requests with missing required fields may also crash or return incorrect status codes instead of proper 400 responses.
